# Define a pattern to match the presence of "lunch" or "Lunch" in the sponsor name
pattern = r'(?i)lunch|lunch'

def regexr_transform(column):
    for row in column:
        # Check if the sponsor name matches the pattern
        if re.search(pattern, row):
            # If it does, return the original string with "offers lunch" appended
            return f'{row} offers lunch'
        else:
            # If it doesn't, return the original string unchanged
            return row

# Apply the function to the sponsor column
sponsors = [
    'TOYO KISEN KAISHA - HING KONG MARU',
    'Comstock Room Of The Palace Hotel',
    'BATTERY PARK HOTEL',
    'The Mayflower Hotel',
    'NOVIOMAGUS',
    'RED STAR LINE',
    'Park Lane',
    'HAMBURG-AMERIKA LINIE',
    'Casina Delle Rose & Lucciola',
    'Hotel Majestic',
    'NIPPON YUSEN KAISHA',
    'The Four Seasons',
    'John Wanamaker',
    'HAMBURG-AMERIKA LINIE',
    'The Biltmore'
]

sponsors_with_lunch = regexr_transform(sponsors)
print(sponsors_with_lunch)
return value
